title: xinjiegit/ben_27_formalization
summary: A Lean 4 and Mathlib proof that there are absolute constants c > 0 and p₀ such that, for every prime p ≥ p₀, the minimum size m(p) of a set A ⊆ 𝔽_p with |A| ≥ 2 and no uniquely represented sum satisfies m(p) ≥ c (log p / log log p)². Here representations are unordered two-element multisets from A, repeated summands are allowed, and "no unique sum" means that every such multiset has a distinct equal-sum mate.

formalizes.title: A near-quadratic lower bound for sets with no unique sums

review.reason: Lean proof of a logarithmic lower bound on sets in finite fields without unique sums.
